subject: Getting differential methylation of a subset of merged samples

messages.author: 068ee0f7a033e952
messages.subject: Getting differential methylation of a subset of merged samples
parts: I have four groups of related samples, I'll call them groups A,B,C,D. I want to make 4 pairwise comparisons (A vs. B, B vs. C etc.) to get differential methylation information. However, I want only the CpGs present that are represented in all 4 groups, so that I can look up the methylation value of any CpG that is significant in the A vs. B comparison in the C vs. D comparsion for example. Is there any way to merge all 4 groups but only compare 2 at a time?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Getting differential methylation of a subset of merged samples
parts:
You can make a methylBase object with A,B,C,D and use reorganize() to make methylBase objects with A-B, B-C etc. and run calculateDiffMeth separately on each new methylBase object.

Best,
Altuna
